errors.title: Could not complete
errors.customObjectKeyTaken: An object with this key already exists. Choose another one.
errors.tooManyCustomObjects: This organization reached the custom object limit. Objects created by modules and plugins are not counted.
errors.customObjectHasRecords: This object has records and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it to hide it.
errors.versionConflict: Someone else changed this item while you were editing. Close and reopen it to see the current version.
errors.recordHasRelations: This record has links that prevent deletion. Remove the links before deleting.
errors.relationRequired: This link is required: the record must stay linked to at least one item.
errors.relationLimitReached: This relation reached its link limit. Remove the current link before adding another one.
errors.recordNotAccessible: You do not have access to this record.
errors.validation: Some data is invalid. Review it and try again.

settings.title: Custom objects
settings.description: Create new record types (such as contracts, properties or projects) with their own fields, layouts, permissions and relationships.
settings.emptyDescription: Create an object to track any kind of information of your business.
settings.listLabel: Custom objects (drag to reorder the navigation)

editor.description: The object starts with the required "Name" field, used as the record title.
editor.keyHint: Lowercase letters and _. Cannot be changed later. Record type: {{recordType}}.
editor.titleFieldHint: Text, email, phone or URL field used as the record title.
editor.ownerEnabledHint: Enables the Owner field and owner/team permissions.
editor.stagedHint: Adds a Stage field and a Stages board that uses the workflow pipelines.
editor.isActiveHint: Inactive objects disappear from the navigation and the API, keeping their data.

errors.keyInvalid: Use only lowercase letters and _ (up to {{max}} characters), starting with a letter.

editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what this object is for

removal.deleteDescription: The object and its fields, views, layouts, reports, permissions and relationships will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
removal.hasRecordsDescription_one: This object has {{count}} record and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it? It disappears from the navigation and the data is kept.
removal.hasRecordsDescription_other: This object has {{count}} records and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it? It disappears from the navigation and the data is kept.
removal.hasRecordsInactive_one: This object is already inactive and still has {{count}} record. Delete the records before deleting the object.
removal.hasRecordsInactive_other: This object is already inactive and still has {{count}} records. Delete the records before deleting the object.

detailSettings.fieldsDescription: Create, edit and reorder the fields of this object.
detailSettings.layoutsDescription: Arrange fields in tabs and sections on forms and on the detail page.
detailSettings.permissionsDescription: Define who can read, create, update, delete, archive and export ({{prefix}}.*) and who sees each field.

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description: Link this object to organizations, people, deals, products or other objects.
relationships.empty: No relationships configured for this object.
relationships.dialogDescription: A relationship links records of two types. Each side gets a tab with the linked records.

one_to_one.title: One to one
one_to_one.description: Each {{from}} links to at most one {{to}}, and each {{to}} to at most one {{from}}.

one_to_many.title: One to many
one_to_many.description: A {{from}} can have many {{toPlural}}, but each {{to}} belongs to a single {{from}}.

many_to_many.title: Many to many
many_to_many.description: {{fromPlural}} and {{toPlural}} link freely, with no limit on either side.

relationships.keysHint: Keys identify the relation on each type (API, imports and filters). Use lowercase letters, digits and _. They cannot be changed later.
relationships.requiredHint: Every {{to}} must be linked to a {{from}} when created, and the last link cannot be removed.
relationships.requiredUnavailable: Only available when the "To" side is a custom object.

onDeleteOptions.unlink: Delete and just remove the links

relationships.summary: On {{from}} it shows as "{{fromLabel}}"; on {{to}} it shows as "{{toLabel}}".
relationships.deleteDescription_one: The relationship and {{count}} link will be removed. Records are not deleted.
relationships.deleteDescription_other: The relationship and all {{count}} links will be removed. Records are not deleted.

errors.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
errors.sameKeys: When both sides have the same type, the keys must differ.
errors.serverValidation: Could not save: check whether the keys are already used by a field or another relation of the chosen types.

records.notFoundDescription: This object does not exist, was deactivated or you are not allowed to see it.
records.dialogDescription: Fill in the data to create the record.

detail.deleteDescription: The record goes to the trash. If links prevent deletion, remove them first.

relations.none: No relationships were configured for this record type.
relations.noAccess: You are not allowed to see the records of this relation.
